title: Fleshy Anvils & Inventories!
description:
An animated fleshy reskin for the inventory, recipe book, and anvil!
In order to use this resource pack, you must also have optifine or animatica!
body: Adding a visceral reskin for the player's inventory as well as making the recipe book a little man! In addition there is also a reskin of the anvil, with the hammer now being made of teeth and hardened blood, with a blood splatter.
